ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) distribution with a calculated contrast ratio of approximately 1:15 (high:low intensity pixels) across the exposed ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large-scale contiguous low-intensity dark-grey/black pigmentation covering >90% of the area, with high-intensity white punctate clusters scattered sparsely on the left lobe and concentrated yellowish-white clusters at the distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped median notch with a measured interior pixel angle of approximately 82 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrated boundary containing multiple micro-peaks and valleys ranging from 2 to 12 pixels in vertical amplitude relative to the local edge trend line.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-lateral sigmoidal curve characterized by an initial convex sweep from the median notch followed by a concave transition leading to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of several circular high-contrast white spots on the medial region of the left lobe and dense, high-intensity clusters on the extreme trailing edges of both distal tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Four parallel, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (light-grey rake marks) oriented diagonally in the upper-mid quadrant of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Parallel linear scarring (rake marks) on the right lobe and probable barnacle colonization marks at the distal tips.
